title: Molecular Signatures of Cutaneous Dupilumab Response
official: Molecular Signatures of Cutaneous Dupilumab Response
summary: This study examines the effect of IL4RA blockade with dupilumab on the immune cells of atopic dermatitis skin lesions.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. 18 years of age or older
2. atopic dermatitis with a EASI (Eczema Area and Severity Index (EASI)) score of ≥7

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Known pregnancy
2. Known immunodeficiencies
3. Known parasitic infection -
